git_delta_compression_model.label: model
git_delta_compression_model.name: git_pack_delta_compression
git_delta_compression_model.description: Analytical comparison of SafeHub per-object AEAD ciphertext vs git pack delta compression on compressible source. Git stores similar blobs as base+delta; SafeHub seals chunked plaintext so cross-blob delta savings are unavailable to the host.
git_delta_compression_model.implication: On compressible corpora, ciphertext_over_plain_git_pack rises relative to incompressible fixtures (host sees no plaintext deltas).
